text: dsh-tencent-channel-fix 是一个 DSH 修复插件：启动时修补 dsh-our-free-model 的 CodeArts 签名传输生命周期，并清理旧版悬空注入及 buddy/workbuddy 的归属 User-Agent。它在模型请求前应用补丁，提供状态查询、手动修复和备份还原命令，以及只读状态接口。补丁按精确锚点检测上游漂移并跳过不匹配项。适合遇到升级后 CodeArts 请求失败的用户。需要本机安装 dsh-our-free-model，无需额外密钥。

dsh-tencent-channel-fix repairs CodeArts transport issues in dsh-our-free-model. It patches at startup and offers status, repair, and backup restore commands plus a read-only status endpoint. It skips upstream drift. Requires dsh-our-free-model; no extra API key.

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · dsh-tencent-channel-fix：Repairs `dsh-our-free-model` at boot so its channels stay usable, and keeps the repair in place across upgrades of that plugin and of DeepSeek Harness.

**Revision 2 covers the break that appeared after the DSH upgrade: CodeArts (Huawei Cloud) turns failing with `CodeArts 签名传输已停止` (`code: UNKNOWN`).** That one is a transport-lifetime bug, not a channel-gate rejection — see [§ The CodeArts transport bug](#the-codearts-transport-bug).

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · dsh-tencent-channel-fix：It still fixes the `400` / `code 11128` returned by the **buddy** and **workbuddy** channels, and removes a dangling injection an earlier revision left behind.

> `请求被拦截，请重新发送` · `Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel` · `INVALID_REQUEST`

---

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · The CodeArts transport bug：`apply()` builds `signedNetwork = createDirectFetch(...)`, registers the CodeArts adapter with `fetchImpl: signedNetwork.fetch`, then closes that transport in its own dispose effect.

The adapter stays registered in the kernel's `llm` service, because `registerAdapterIdempotent()` deliberately keeps the existing route on a duplicate registration (`插件 fiber 重启竞态，保留现有路由并跳过本次注册`).

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · The CodeArts transport bug：So once the plugin fiber is disposed and re-created — an OFM hot reload, an in-app upgrade, or a DSH upgrade that re-applies the profile — every CodeArts request still runs through the **previous** adapter, whose fetch points at the **closed** transport. The first call throws and the turn ends.

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · The CodeArts transport bug：The repair replaces the captured instance with a closure over a process-wide lane, and rewires all three consumers (auth service, adapter, RPC fetcher). The lane is symbol-keyed on `globalThis`, so it also survives the module purge OFM performs during a hot reload: an adapter retained from an earlier generation follows the successor transport instead of calling into a dead one.

---

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · The buddy / workbuddy channel gate：Tencent's channel gate rejects **two** independent things inside the request. Both must have been fixed; fixing one still returned `400`.

> OFM 2.5.9+ retired these channels outright (`isRetiredProvider()` returns true for both), and the CodeArts-carrying 2.5.8 build no longer contains the `CONTENT_FINGERPRINTS` table the second fix edited. That fix is therefore retired in revision 2; the attribution UA sanitizer is kept because it stays correct wherever the channels still exist.

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · What is actually wrong：Tencent's channel gate rejects **two** independent things inside the request. Both must be fixed; fixing one still returns `400`.

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · 1. The attribution User-Agent：`dsh-our-free-model/adapter/kernel.js` publishes the harness identity as the request's `User-Agent`:

```
deepseek-harness/0.2.1-rc.2 (+https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
```

The `deepseek-harness` token is on the gate's blocklist. The check is **case-insensitive** — `DeepSeek-Harness/0.2.1` is rejected too. Every other UA tested was accepted, including `curl`, `node`, `axios`, `undici`, `codex_cli_rs`, `claude-cli`, `opencode`, and the empty UA.

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · 2. The harness identity sentence in the system prompt *(historical — fix retired in revision 2)*：DSH's base system prompt opens with:

```
You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.
```

The gate treats `powered by DeepSeek Harness` as a **content fingerprint** and rejects the whole request when it appears in the system message.
section: 2. The harness identity sentence in the system prompt *(historical — fix retired in revision 2)*

text:
dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · 2. The harness identity sentence in the system prompt *(historical — fix retired in revision 2)*：This one is subtle: `dsh-our-free-model` already has a fingerprint-rewriting mechanism (`rewriteTencentContentFingerprints`), but it only runs on the **gateway** path (`convertMessage` / `toMessages`). The **direct adapter** path — the one `buddy` actually used — assembled its system message with a bare `messages.unshift(...)` and never called the rewriter. So the sentence went out verbatim.

Measured on the real endpoint (OFM 2.5.7 era, while the Tencent channels still existed):

The harness identity sentence in the system prompt *(historical — fix retired in revision 2)*：Revision 1 patched this by injecting a rewriter call into the direct path. On the pinned 2.5.8 bundle that call references a function the bundle no longer contains, so it turned a `400` into a `ReferenceError`. Revision 2 **removes** that injection (`legacy-direct-rewrite`) and retires the fingerprint-table edit, whose anchor no longer exists upstream.

text:
dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · Why a plugin, and not a patch：Both defects are text inside `dsh-our-free-model`. Its updater rewrites those files wholesale, so a hand edit is lost on its next update — **that is exactly how this bug comes back**. It was fixed by hand once, returned after the plugin updated, and had to be fixed again.

This plugin repairs the two files on every boot instead:
section: Why a plugin, and not a patch

text:
dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · Why a plugin, and not a patch：- Written **once**, in `apply()`, before any model request — `pack.js` and `adapter/kernel.js` are imported lazily by that plugin on first use, so the write lands well ahead of the module cache.
- **Idempotent**: a repaired file is detected by marker and left byte-identical.
- **Drift-aware**: if upstream moves an anchor, that patch is skipped and reported — never forced, never half-written.
- **Self-reverting**: files are backed up before writing and `node --check`-ed after; any failure restores the originals.
section: Why a plugin, and not a patch

text:
dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · Why a plugin, and not a patch：An upgrade of `dsh-our-free-model` becomes a self-healing event instead of a regression.

---

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · Scope：- Touches exactly two files, both inside `dsh-our-free-model`: `adapter/kernel.js` and `vendor/channel-pack/pack.js`.
- Nothing else changes: no provider, model row, route, credential, or DSH file.
- The content rewrite is **provider-scoped** inside `pack.js` (`TENCENT_PROVIDERS = ["buddy", "workbuddy"]`), so every other channel passes through untouched.
- Attribution stays meaningful: the User-Agent remains present and non-empty and keeps its version — only the blocked token and URL are dropped.

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · Verify：```bash
npm test        # 29 tests, no network, no real install touched
```

The suite builds targets in a temp directory from fixtures that reproduce both shipped shapes — `kernel.js` in LF, `pack.js` in CRLF — and covers idempotency, line-ending preservation, ambiguity detection, per-patch drift, dry-run, and backup restore. It also extracts the injected `sanitizeAttributionUserAgent` via `new Function` and asserts its real output.

To confirm against a live install without writing anything:

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · Verify：```bash
node -e "import('dsh-tencent-channel-fix/patcher').then(m => console.log(m.formatStatus(m.resolveTarget({}))))"
```

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · dsh-tencent-channel-fix：在启动时修复 `dsh-our-free-model`，让它的渠道保持可用，并在该插件与 DeepSeek Harness 升级后自动重打。

**revision 2 针对的是 DSH 升级后新出现的问题：CodeArts（华为云）渠道报 `CodeArts 签名传输已停止`（`code: UNKNOWN`）。** 这是传输对象的生命周期 bug，不是渠道网关的拒绝——见 [§ CodeArts 传输 bug](#codearts-传输-bug)。

它同时继续修 **buddy** / **workbuddy** 渠道的 `400` / `code 11128`，并清掉上一版留下的一个悬空注入。

> `请求被拦截，请重新发送` · `Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel` · `INVALID_REQUEST`

---

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · CodeArts 传输 bug：`apply()` 先 `signedNetwork = createDirectFetch(...)`，把 CodeArts 适配器用 `fetchImpl: signedNetwork.fetch` 注册上去，然后在自己的 dispose 里关闭这个传输对象。

而适配器仍留在内核的 `llm` 服务里——`registerAdapterIdempotent()` 遇到重复注册时会**故意保留已存在的路由**（`插件 fiber 重启竞态，保留现有路由并跳过本次注册`）。

于是只要插件 fiber 被销毁并重建一次（OFM 热重载、应用内升级，或 DSH 升级后重新应用 profile），CodeArts 请求仍然走**上一代**适配器，而它的 fetch 指向**已关闭**的传输对象。第一次调用就抛异常，这一轮直接失败。

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · CodeArts 传输 bug：修复方式是把「捕获的实例」换成「对一条进程级通道的闭包」，并改写全部三个使用方（鉴权服务、适配器、RPC fetcher）。通道用 symbol 挂在 `globalThis` 上，所以 OFM 热重载清理模块缓存时它也依然存在：上一代留下的适配器会跟随新一代传输，而不是调用一个已经死掉的。

---

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · buddy / workbuddy 的渠道网关：渠道网关同时拒绝了请求里的**两个**独立内容，只修一个仍然是 `400`。

> OFM 2.5.9+ 已彻底下架这两个渠道（`isRetiredProvider()` 对两者都返回 true），而仍带 CodeArts 的 2.5.8 构建里也已经没有第二个修复所编辑的 `CONTENT_FINGERPRINTS` 表。因此该修复在 revision 2 中退役；归属 UA 的清洗保留——在渠道仍然存在的环境里它依然是正确的。

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · 1. 归属 User-Agent：`dsh-our-free-model/adapter/kernel.js` 把 harness 身份当作 `User-Agent` 发出去：

```
deepseek-harness/0.2.1-rc.2 (+https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
```

`deepseek-harness` 这个 token 在黑名单上，且**大小写不敏感**——`DeepSeek-Harness/0.2.1` 一样被拦。实测其它所有 UA 都放行，包括 `curl`、`node`、`axios`、`undici`、`codex_cli_rs`、`claude-cli`、`opencode` 和空 UA。

dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · 2. 系统提示词里的身份句：DSH 的基础 system prompt 开头是：

```
You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.
```

网关把 `powered by DeepSeek Harness` 当作**内容指纹**，出现在 system 里就整条拒绝。

这一点很隐蔽：`dsh-our-free-model` 本来就有指纹改写机制（`rewriteTencentContentFingerprints`），但它**只在网关路径**（`convertMessage` / `toMessages`）里调用。而 `buddy` 走的是**直连 adapter 路径**，那里的 system 拼装是裸的 `messages.unshift(...)`，从来没调过改写器——所以那句话原样发了出去。

真机实测：

| 原版 system + 已修 UA | `400` `code 11128` |
| 改写 system + 已修 UA | `200 OK` |

同一道校验还会拦 `Main branch (you will usually use this for PRs)`、`You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.` 和 `x-anthropic-billing-header`——这也是各类 CLI 代理项目撞到同一个报错的原因。本插件只修 DSH 自己会发的这两处。

text:
dsh-tencent-channel-fix README · 为什么做成插件，而不是打个补丁：两处缺陷都是 `dsh-our-free-model` 里的文本。它的更新器是整文件覆盖，手工改的东西在下次更新时必然丢失——**这个 bug 上次就是这么复发的**：先手工修好，插件一升级又回来了，再修一次。

所以这个插件改成**每次启动重打**：

- 只写一次，在 `apply()` 里、任何模型请求之前——`pack.js` 和 `adapter/kernel.js` 是被那个插件懒加载的，写入远早于模块缓存。
- **幂等**：已修的文件靠 marker 识别，逐字节不动。
- **认漂移**：上游把锚点挪走时，该 patch 跳过并报告，不硬改、不写一半。
- **失败自还原**：写前备份、写后 `node --check`，任何一步失败就还原原文件。

于是 `dsh-our-free-model` 升级不再是回归，而是一次自愈。

---
section: 为什么做成插件，而不是打个补丁
